name: Tetherow (high desert, Bend)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours; same keys as pnw.json plus F0-F2). Tetherow, Bend OR, 3,700-3,900 ft on the east flank of the Cascades: firm fescue fairways and greens a dry, slightly yellow green against the native ground (sampled from the OSIP 2024 photo: fairway #98a55c, green #acb275, native #9d9984, pumice bunkers #cec7ac, ponds #435856); the native rough of bunchgrass and fescue on pumice, cured to a cool grey-tan (F0-F2, inside config fescue_areas; the mown rough beside the fairways in G3-G5); off the course (L0-L2) the grey-olive sage steppe; pale grey-cream pumice sand (S0-S2), lighter and greyer than beach sand; dark teal ponds. Trees: ponderosa pine and western juniper; bushes sage, bitterbrush, manzanita and heather (assets-src/trees_tetherow.py). Hues pushed toward the game's saturated style. Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
